leadText: Izabe Island (Japanese: イザベ島 Izabe Island) is an -exclusive location in the Hoenn region. It is a large island situated between Mossdeep City and Sootopolis City. It contains a wide variety of environments, from deserted areas to snow-covered mountains. Its highest peak is known as the Square Top, a cube-shaped rock formation on a mountain. and traveled across the island from A Cacturne for the Worse to Do I Hear a Ralts?.
plainText:
Izabe Island (Japanese: イザベ島 Izabe Island) is an -exclusive location in the Hoenn region. It is a large island situated between Mossdeep City and Sootopolis City. It contains a wide variety of environments, from deserted areas to snow-covered mountains. Its highest peak is known as the Square Top, a cube-shaped rock formation on a mountain. and traveled across the island from A Cacturne for the Worse to Do I Hear a Ralts?.

==In animation==
The annual Purika City took place in A Cacturne for the Worse. where met her new rival Harley. Despite Harley's underhanded tactics during the final round, May won her fourth Ribbon.

Sigourney is the current sage of Izabe Island. In Claydol Big and Tall, he explained "The Great Destruction", a catastrophic event caused by a that threatened the island over a thousand years ago. Claydol remains sealed inside a stone to avoid another catastrophic event.

While on Izabe Island, Brock's Lombre evolved into a , a , and Max befriended a that he promised to start his with.
